3.name: Abjuration Savant & Arcane Ward (Abjurer)
3.description: Gain two Abjuration spells in your spellbook and weave a magical Arcane Ward that absorbs damage whenever you cast Abjuration spells.

6.name: Projected Ward (Abjurer)
6.description: Use your Reaction when a creature within 30 feet takes damage to have your Arcane Ward absorb that damage instead.

10.name: Spell Breaker (Abjurer)
10.description: Always have Counterspell and Dispel Magic prepared, cast Dispel Magic as a Bonus Action adding PB to the check, and retain spell slots when a dispel/counter fails.

14.name: Spell Resistance (Abjurer)
14.description: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells and Resistance to the damage of spells.

arcane_ward.name: Arcane Ward
arcane_ward.hint: Protective ward with max HP equal to 2 x Wizard level + INT mod; recharges when casting Abjuration spells.

3.name: Divination Savant & Portent (Diviner)
3.description: Gain two Divination spells in your spellbook and roll two d20 Portent dice after a Long Rest to replace d20 Tests made by you or visible creatures.

6.name: Expert Divination (Diviner)
6.description: Casting a Divination spell of Level 2 or higher with a spell slot regains an expended spell slot of lower level (up to Level 5).

10.name: The Third Eye (Diviner)
10.description: As a Bonus Action, gain Darkvision (120 ft), Ethereal Sight, Greater Comprehension, or See Invisibility until your next rest.

14.name: Greater Portent (Diviner)
14.description: Roll three d20s for your Portent feature instead of two.

portent.name: Portent
portent.hint: Roll Portent d20s after each Long Rest (2 dice at L3, 3 dice at L14) to replace visible d20 Tests.

3.name: Evocation Savant & Potent Cantrip (Evoker)
3.description: Gain two Evocation spells in your spellbook, and when you miss with your cantrip attack roll or a target succeeds on its saving throw against your damaging cantrip, it still takes half damage.

6.name: Sculpt Spells (Evoker)
6.description: Create pockets of safety in your Evocation spells so chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws and take no damage.

10.name: Empowered Evocation (Evoker)
10.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any Wizard Evocation spell you cast.

14.name: Overchannel (Evoker)
14.description: Deal maximum damage with a Level 1–5 Wizard spell once per Long Rest (subsequent uses deal self-damage unless rested).

3.name: Illusion Savant & Improved Illusions (Illusionist)
3.description: Gain two Illusion spells in your spellbook, cast Illusion spells without Verbal components, enhance Minor Illusion, and cast Summon Beast/Fey as illusions.

6.name: Phantasmal Creatures (Illusionist)
6.description: Always have Summon Beast and Summon Fey prepared, and cast either once per Long Rest without a spell slot (half HP, Illusion school).

10.name: Illusory Self (Illusionist)
10.description: Use your Reaction when hit by an attack roll to force the attack to miss via an illusory double (recharges on Short/Long Rest or Level 2+ spell slot).

14.name: Illusory Reality (Illusionist)
14.description: As a Bonus Action, make one inanimate, nonmagical object inside a Level 1+ Illusion spell you cast temporarily real for 1 minute.
